name: One of Few
body:
You can further limit the number of random choices for your We Are One racial trait.

Prerequisite: Xax.

Benefit: Before you roll for your We Are One racial trait, choose and write down two numbers from 1 to 6. You may reroll for your We Are One racial trait if either number that you have written down is rolled.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
